summary: Frontend-only smoke test after store.js syncFromCloud restoration. Login succeeded with test.user@arun.com. All protected routes (/home, /hr, /vendor, /bill, /purchase, /expense, /final, /gm) loaded cleanly with no webpack 'Compiled with problems' overlay and no React runtime error overlay. HR Dashboard tab rendered the new CelebrationBanner with data-testid='hr-celebration-banner', showing the Hindi empty-state fallback ('Aane wale 7 din me koi birthday ya work anniversary nahi hai.') — valid pass since the shared Employees list has 0 entries for this user. store.js lines 1080-1103 verified: `export const syncFromCloud = async () => { ... }` is a syntactically valid function declaration again.

issues: Pre-existing (unrelated) React hydration warnings: <span> rendered as child of <option> in several <select> dropdowns. Not caused by current fix but should be cleaned up — remove the inner <span> wrapper that visual-editor injects, or render option labels as plain text.

critical_code_review_comments: store.js syncFromCloud block (lines 1081-1103) is now valid. Consider adding a unit/lint pre-commit check that catches orphan `return` statements to prevent future regressions.

Pre-existing React warning: <option> children must be plain strings/numbers, not <span>. The visual-editor wrapper is causing hydration warnings on BillProcessing (L795), PurchaseManagement (L182), ExpenseProcess (L288), Reports (L784). Harmless but noisy.
seed_data_creation: None — did not create employees since empty-state fallback was explicitly stated as a valid pass by main agent.

If user wants to see populated banner, seed an employee with DOB within 7 days and step=5. The <option><span> hydration warnings exist across BillProcessing/Purchase/Expense/Reports and are pre-existing — not in scope for this iteration.
rca of the issue: RCA: Previous edit stripped the `export const syncFromCloud = async () => {` opening line in store.js, leaving a `return snap;` outside any function and breaking webpack compile. Fix: opening line restored. Verified via live preview — no overlay, all routes render, HR banner mounts with data-testid='hr-celebration-banner'.
